title: Thunder and Lightning! Elemental Power!
overview: The Grand Masquerade Bey Tournament is here! Bladers have gathered at a mysterious "Power Spot", overflowing with elemental energy. Bel faces off with the masked Blader Quadra.

title: The Rebirth! Divine Belfyre!
overview: Bel can't get the mysterious masked Blader off his mind. When he's facing Ranzo, Bel sees Quadra. This doesn't sit right with Ranzo, who threatens to exit the Theater of the Abyss.

title: Rise Up! Gambit Dragon Soars!
overview: World-class Blader and loveable goofball, Dante Koryu, has arrived at Phantom's Gate to challenge the Dark Prince. Pax has ordered Quadra to battle Bel once again.

title: Depths Below! Abyssal Tournament!
overview: Pri and Hanna have a sleepover at the Suiro house. Hanna's excited to tell Pri all about her family. Pri finds a special Blading delivery from her brother overseas.

title: Dragon vs Pandora! Rising Tides!
overview: Pri removes her mask to reveal herself as the enigmatic Quadra. Pax tells Pri to keep her mask on while battling or else risk ruining their research data.

title: Howls of Terror! Kerbeus Returns!
overview: Bel, Ranzo and Hanna find a puppet show that offers a Bey tournament! Bel and Ranzo go up against a three-headed guard dog and Pri handles being both a puppeteer and a Blader.

title: Theater of the Dark Prince! Monstrous Missions!
overview: Ken has a bunch of training exercises for Bel, Ranzo and Pri that will hone their skills for both puppetry as well as Blading! And when training's over, it's time to Battle!

title: Peerless! Xiphoid Xcalius!
overview: Valt offers anyone to face off with his super-powerful friend. So, Bel, Pri and Ranzo go to the Shakadera family dojo just as the mystery Blader completes a 300 Blader challenge.

title: Striking Flames! Ferocious Battle!
overview: Can Bel, Pri and Ranzo keep up with the Shakadera training regimen? It's time to face Xander in a one-on-one battle! Ranzo is confident that he has got what it takes.

title: Dark Devotion! Mighty Sword!
overview: The Bladers take a quick snack break. Jiji comes to the rescue with his signature scrumptious feast. Xander presents Bel with a challenge over who gets Jiji to stay with them.

title: Surge Ahead! Battle Camp Clash!
overview: Bel, Ranzo and Pri have been invited to Battle Island, where rookie Bladers gather to train and compete! They meet a pair of brothers named Hikaru and Hyuga Hizashi.

title: Hurricane Winds! Twister Pandora!
overview: Training at the battle camp is hard, and some Bladers have more trouble following Wakiya's rules than others. Bel goes off script, declaring a rematch with his new rival Hyuga.

title: Tag-Team! Break the Limit!
overview: It's the climax of Wakiya's battle camp. The assembled Bladers participate in a Tag-Team tournament! The Hizashi brothers are skilled at Battling as a team, but others aren't.

title: Turbo Time! Zeal Achilles!
overview: Aiger Akabane has arrived at Phantom's Gate! Aiger has no choice but to test out the new Achilles on the Dark Prince. There's a condition: Bel will have to join forces with Pri!

title: Chivalry Unbound! Whirl Knight!
overview: Skilled Bladers from all over the globe were chosen to compete in the Champion's Challenge Tournament, including Valt's fellow BC Sol Blader, Kit Lopez.

title: Wild Dash! Battle Marathon!
overview: The Champion's Challenge Tournament keeps on spinning, but one important face is missing: the Dark Prince is nowhere to be seen!

title: Blazing Battles! Aether Stadium!
overview: Something monumental was found hidden deep beneath the Grand Masquerade Bey Tournament's stage and it might just change the face of Blading forever.

title: Darkness Unleashed! Winds of Change!
overview: It's the final stage of the Champion's Challenge, and the pressure is on when Pax gives Pri some strict instructions on how to use Pandora.

title: Champion's Challenge! Radiant Finals!
overview: Everyone has something to prove when Kit and Bel are set to face off for the chance to challenge Aiger!

title: Invincible Shadows! Aiger vs Bel!
overview: Bel has climbed his way to the top and earned the right to challenge Aiger for a chance to become the world champion. Beys and Elements will collide in this epic title match!

title: Dire Destiny! Ruin Pandemonium!
overview: Pax Forsythe has returned to the Blading stage with a vengeance and a new Bey. Inspired by his loss against Aiger, Bel has evolved Belfyre into something stronger than ever before.

title: Shining Stars! Lodestar Battle Tournament!
overview: Wakiya's new Lodestar Battle Tournament has everything expected of a Beyblade competition, but figuring out who will get to enter will be a challenge in and of it itself!

title: Vroom-vroom Revolution! A Hero's Journey!
overview: The Hizashi brothers vroom-vroom their way into the Lodestar Battle Tournament! Facing evolved forms of Valtryek and Belfyre, will they be able to overcome the odds?

title: Achilles vs Pandemonium! Clashes of Light!
overview: Aiger faces off against Pax in the the Lodestar Battle Tournament. As the battle rages on, Pax’s desperation and obsession starts to make Shu and some of the other legends nervous.

title: Resonance vs Elemental!
overview: Pri just can’t believe what Pax is willing to do to unleash the greatest elemental power possible. With the help of the Dark Prince, Pri takes her launch power to new heights.

title: Elemental Battle! Ultimate Showdown!
overview: Bel’s preparing for his semi-final match against Pax, and this fierce battle is sure to remind everyone why they love Blading!
